svg.title: Digitization verification overlay on original ChamberSafe plot
svg.desc: Original PNG is shown unchanged. Magenta overlays mark accepted blue horizontal centers; teal overlays mark accepted orange horizontal centers. Crosshairs mark axis calibration ticks. Unresolved strokes have no centerline overlay.
svg.text: DIGITIZED, NOT RAW · Centerline overlays: magenta = baseline; teal = hot.
Crosshairs = tick calibration. Original source is embedded unchanged. Blank overlays = unresolved pixels.
